hypothesis: Implementation correction only: rerun the same initial parent, sources, self/public contexts, parameter maps, penalties, conditional ridge, LBFGS60/90 and acceptance after recomputing unchanged author AGA assignment from current A at every objective and line-search evaluation. Do not warm-start from either evaluated failed control. No new method claim.
construction: Original target/base weights, fixed target classifier, existing task-layer inputs (16384) and all fixed generated native views only. No real images, partner, test, recovery support images, or exposed counterexamples used to construct. Bias follows a-(Anew-A)beta. The task SVD32 is a soft squared response-projection penalty, not a hard zero-update rule. One final point per task. Native KL, normalized reconstruction error, source hinge losses before/after probability calibration and soft SVD term have unit weights. B range violation squared has weight100. Standard torch LBFGS, history5, strong_wolfe, max_iter60/max_eval90; library line search can exceed nominal max_eval and actual evaluations are logged.
algebra: For fixed A, R=[B,b] is the exact ridge minimizer of the same two source populations, using task original rho and fixed teacher outputs. Cholesky autodiff includes R(A). The explicit finite ridge optimum, not an unconstrained envelope derivative for the full protection loss, is differentiated. No global or native-distribution guarantee is claimed.
numerical_check: Same original initial parent679ca452, central difference1e-5 and relative tolerance2%. If the actual assignment makes this check discontinuous or inconclusive, save and stop without a new model; no epsilon/model/tolerance search. A prior check at an existing frozen model passed at3.116e-5; this does not imply the initial-point check passes.
evaluation: One MNIST only if source eligible. Freeze one final point, execute authorAGA, then compare its full-model synthetic public-base forward with the construction teacher-match count. Stop before real images if they differ. Then complete native/TA0.5/AGA target+both, matched B replacement and fixed ProDistill. No automatic cross-task or eight-expert expansion.
separate_existing_benchmark: Evaluate the existing unchanged centered-readout three releases in eight-expert TA0.2 on seven verified datasets. This fills a missing fixed-weight setting; it is not a new defense point or rescue of a failed candidate. No ProDistill retraining on existing releases.
claim_limit: This is one hypothesis, not an established new algorithm or promise of improvement. Standard ridge, SVD, variable projection and LBFGS are known. No additional matrices/layers, fake GPU load, unbounded search, or automated heartbeat.
source_eligibility: Require the same native source decision count as the conditional initial fit, legal A/B ranges and native error limit, and fewer teacher matches than that initial fit in every public/self, raw/calibrated, TA/B-reset context. Stop source-only otherwise; no source, rank, solver or threshold changes.
trigger_evidence: Frozen same-view evaluation: public-base teacher matches18/800 vs actual-partner792/800; cached vs full forward maximum logit difference2.861e-5. This supports a reference-context gap for the closed point; it does not establish universal causation or guarantee the control will work.
matching: Unchanged author solve_permutation(current_A.float(),public_A.float()) each objective evaluation; differentiate the current selected branch only. Finite line search uses recomputed actual assignments. No claim of a smooth global objective.
